Name: Oku's Modern Torch
Author: okubunny
Description:
[color=#f4cccc][size=2][b]Working as of November 2024 - Please leave a comment if you are experiencing a bug[/b][/size][/color]

[size=4]Torches a bit too primitive for your farm? I gotchu <3  

[/size]This mod replaces the torch and turns it into a modern lawn/garden lamp. Looks pretty good on fences too ^_^

[color=#f4cccc][b]How to get it working:[/b][/color]

- Have smapi installed
- Download Content Patcher if you don't have it
- Extract my mod file and put it in your Mods folder

[b][color=#f4cccc]Planned updates
[/color][/b]
- Add different color options (bronze, silver, white)

I'll also take any suggestions you have :3

[b][color=#f4cccc]Known issues / Things to keep in mind:

[/color][/b]- Since this is a replacement/override mod, the torches in the mines will change as well. The torch's flame sprite has also been changed to a transparent image so if you are using any mods that use the flame sprites, the fire in those mods will be invisible. These things are out of my control sadly!
-There is also no way to make this mod for AT, since the torch is not compatible with it. (believe me I tried... 😭)

[b][color=#f4cccc]I'm new to modding so let me know if there's any issues![/color][/b]

feel free to edit the png files for personal use, I don't mind.

[color=#fff2cc][size=4]Want the house pictured in the photo? Get it here: [/size][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29274][color=#fff2cc][size=4][u]Oku's Suburban Farmhouse[/u][/size][/color][/url]
